scope: 17 open implementation acceptance containers plus #9 and #1/#10 Full followups

policy.original_acceptance_criteria: Preserve every original checkbox verbatim; children add evidence references, never replace or weaken the original AC.
policy.dependencies: Preserve original native parent dependencies. prerequisite_keys are additional child ordering; publishing must resolve keys to actual issue IDs. A blocked parent is not made ready by a child label.
policy.thresholds: Freeze before running; preserve all failed attempts. R1=numerical_failed; G6/Full not passed. #20 sustained 1x and #33 final-combination RateUnmet remain real failures.
policy.luna_scope: One reviewed 1–4-file edit or ONE existing bounded verification run. Existing tests are gates, not busywork tickets. No unknown native integration is Luna-ready.
policy.astra_scope: Explicit expert resolution/implementation boundary. If owned paths or command need further discovery, stop with needs_astra_resolution and publish a tighter implementation child before Luna dispatch.
policy.runtime: One exclusive runtime lease per FC/model/UE run, fresh output directory, exact hashes/argv/cwd/process ownership. A failed run ends the child attempt; no automatic retries, parameter changes or production promotion.
policy.model_policy: This proposal selects execution tier, not subagent settings. Existing AGENTS gpt-6-astra-only delegation policy still applies; GPT-5.6 Luna handoff must be a user-selected primary session unless policy is explicitly changed.
policy.completion: Child completion never auto-closes parent. Main independently checks raw evidence, all original AC and retained dependencies before parent closure.

starting_facts.20: Pause/four-tick step/continue/cold reset already evidenced. Three 1x attempts failed (47.1/41.1/23.7s); no blind rerun.
starting_facts.25: Hex native candidate built, static 18 checks and six-channel seam exist. PX4 attempts 1/2 rejected ground parameter format/zero coverage before arming. Attempt3 observed normal landing at /root/wksim-hex-flight-px4-03/hex-px4-03/result.json; independent raw audit pending. UE candidate built and static six-rotor/rejection/freeze fixtures passed, no actual flight stream. AP flight/cold reset/both-stack LIVE UE remain.
starting_facts.33: Separate PV and mixed candidates passed. Final combined firmware/control PV three real rounds failed rate contract; formal wiring exists but not promoted.
starting_facts.35: PID source oracle run2 1884x10 values PASS, fixed protocol. Candidate runtime and 14 pure tests exist, no FC/model/preflight. Full 1ms independent audit and product UI missing.
starting_facts.40: ArUco consumer and 12 offline tests done; genuine UE marker scene and closed-loop flight absent.
starting_facts.45: GNSS event controller/10 offline tests done; PX4 HIL_GPS seam known. AP JSON position is physical truth, not GNSS; native sensor injection needs expert work.
